svg.text: Who lights the targets a long-smoke destroyer hits from its own smoke? Per shot, not one snapshot
Each bar adds to 100%. Shots = distinct firing moments; damage = credited damage; per smoke = average of each smoke's own split. Evidence only: detection and nearness, not proof of who spotted.
A. What the data shows at each shot: was the target radar-lit (and from where), detected, and who was the nearest friendly ship

Radar-lit by a radar ship elsewhere
Detected, no radar; nearest ally a ship outside the smoke
Target not detected at the shot
